name: Artiodactyla
blurb: Pigs, cattle, giraffes, hippos and whales. Whales are the closest living relatives of hippopotamuses.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), posterior mean and 95% HPD
clock.note: Tarver et al.'s crown Artiodactyla (node 53: 61.40 Ma, 59.38–63.40) contains a lineage outside pig + cow that is not in this selection, so the split of pigs from cattle and whales is their node 54.
